description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade5 class within the Opencart installation upgrade system. The class contains an index() method responsible for performing database schema modifications and configuration updates during an upgrade process from version 5. It handles tasks such as altering tables, serializing/deserializing settings, adding missing configuration keys, removing obsolete settings, and updating language configurations.

classes.name: Upgrade5
classes.description: Handles version 5 upgrade procedures for the Opencart installation, including database schema modifications and configuration data migrations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs database alterations, updates configuration settings, removes obsolete data, and prepares the system for upgrade to the next version.
